The visitor/invitation/URL group is readable but smaller than the description and schedule text; the invitation wraps at the word boundary before 느껴보세요.

substantive_visual.observation: The complete product, its enlarged warm underside and paper fold light ridge materially show structure and desk-light experience.

product_identity.observation: Deep forest-green finish, wide horizontally curved shade, two connected supports and oval base visible together in the complete product.

hangul.observation: Native body syllables have steady width, baseline and apertures; usage720 word spacing and semantic line breaks remain visible. Visitor letters are smaller than the description.

function_contact.observation: Illuminated underside, warm paper/desk light and base contact visible; no human hand action was requested or introduced.

local_finish.observation: Photo crop boundaries and fold edges remain coherent; no obvious detached column, missing base contact or doubled component contour.

format.observation: One flat opaque landscape poster; no mockup, comparison panel, company logo, QR or watermark visible.
